speaker: Unknown
en: Hello.
zh: 你好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for coming.
zh: 感谢大家前来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to talk to you about agentic sites, how we call it is building hyper-personalized websites.
zh: 我要和你们聊聊智能体网站，我们称之为构建超个性化网站。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not going to just talk about it.
zh: 我不只是讲一讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to show you what we're building.
zh: 我会给你们展示我们正在构建的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been working on this project for a bit now, and we'll try to show you what is possible today with AI.
zh: 我做这个项目已经有一段时间了，我们会试着向你们展示今天用 AI 能做到什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I work at Adobe.
zh: 我在 Adobe 工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a principal scientist at a product that not many people know, Adobe Experience Manager, Content Management.
zh: 我是一个产品线的首席科学家，这个产品没多少人知道，就是 Adobe Experience Manager,内容管理。

speaker: Unknown
en: We run a lot of websites, properties for big brands, and my background is in open source, contributing to a lot of foundations and projects.
zh: 我们为大型品牌运营很多网站和资产，我的背景是开源，为很多基金会和项目做过贡献。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are agentic sites and how are we building this thing?
zh: 什么是智能体网站，我们是怎么构建这个东西的？

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are looking for sites that are looking at what intent the user browsing has, what is the user doing, what is the user trying to achieve.
zh: 我们要做的是那些能识别浏览用户意图的网站：用户在做什么，用户想达成什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the end goal is to personalize these pages for the current user browsing so that eventually this drives higher engagement or conversions, whatever the marketing teams want to achieve.
zh: 最终目标是为当前浏览的用户个性化这些页面，这样最终能带来更高的参与度或转化率，或者营销团队想达成的任何目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: And these pages are personalized in real time based on the user that is accessing the site and what is the user doing.
zh: 这些页面是基于正在访问网站的用户以及用户正在做什么，实时进行个性化的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The stack we're using is AM Edge Delivery.
zh: 我们用的技术栈是 AM Edge Delivery。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is the part of the product we have where all the content is on the edge.
zh: 这是我们产品中所有内容都放在边缘上的部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we have a backend service that powers this experience with different LLM providers, LLM services.
zh: 然后我们有一个后端服务，用不同的 LLM 提供商、LLM 服务来支撑这个体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: We use Cerebras for fast inference, or we can use also, we tried Bedrock and a bunch of others.
zh: 我们用 Cerebras 做快速推理，我们也可以用，我们试过 Bedrock 和其他一堆。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll be showing Cerebras today, and you will see the reason why.
zh: 今天我会展示 Cerebras,你们会看到原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: The engine that is personalizing this is in the rich content and blocks.
zh: 做个性化的引擎在富内容和区块中。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, different blocks on the site are customized depending on what the user personize.
zh: 所以，网站上的不同区块会根据用户的个性化情况被定制。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't want the whole site to be generated.
zh: 我们不想让整个网站都被生成。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, if you talk to marketing people, they have a very strict brand guidelines.
zh: 我是说，如果你和营销人员聊，他们有非常严格的品牌指南。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't want to just came up with or have some hallucinations there.
zh: 你不会想只是凭空生成，或者在那里出现一些幻觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what is personalized is different sections of the site.
zh: 所以被个性化的是网站的不同部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we use the whole site as a corpus.
zh: 我们把整个网站用语料库来用。

speaker: Unknown
en: We built a rug from the whole site.
zh: 我们从整个网站构建了一个 rug。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what is generated is grounded on the existing site.
zh: 所以生成的内容是基于现有网站的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We try to solve the problem where one side fits all.
zh: 我们试图解决“一边适合所有人”的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want hyper-personalized experiences.
zh: 我们想要超个性化的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, we want to help our customers to do more automatic authoring, so not having to create thousands of different variations of the site, but use AI for this, and then do these multiple layers of personalization.
zh: 另外，我们想帮我们的客户做更多自动化创作，不用创建成千上万个不同的网站变体，而是用 AI 来做这个，然后再做多层的个性化。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some examples of what we're doing or showing the demo is an instant persona adaptation, query generation when the user search for something on the site, the page with the results is customized for them, and also something like recommendations where after you browse the site for a period of time, we can create a page that recommends something based on what we think you are looking for.
zh: 我们正在做或展示的 demo 的一些例子有：即时角色适配、用户在网站上搜索某样东西时的查询生成(带结果的页面会为他们定制)，还有类似推荐的东西——在你浏览网站一段时间后，我们可以创建一个页面，基于我们认为你在寻找的东西来推荐一些内容。

speaker: Unknown
en: For marketeers, they can define this strategy on natural language and they can use analytics to drive the loop of personalization and what is the end goal and how this goes back again to change, to adapt the personalization to improve that whole cycle.
zh: 对于营销人员来说，他们可以用自然语言定义这个策略，并且可以用分析数据来驱动个性化的循环——最终目标是什么，以及这如何再反馈回去改变、调整个性化，从而改进整个循环。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody's talking about loops in this conference, so that's one of the loops there.
zh: 这次大会每个人都在谈循环，所以那就是其中一个循环。

speaker: Unknown
en: How'd the architecture look like?
zh: 架构看起来是什么样的？

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's a dynamic front end with some blocks, what I mentioned before, and with Edge Delivery Services, it's basically you compose these blocks and they are updated on real time with the AI.
zh: 它是一个动态前端，带有一些我之前提到的区块，在 Edge Delivery Services 中，基本上就是你组合这些区块，然后它们被 AI 实时更新。

speaker: Unknown
en: The backend, we...
zh: 后端，我们……

speaker: Unknown
en: We do the evaluation of the models and the providers, and one thing we realized is that this is very dependent on the site.
zh: 我们做模型和提供商的评估，我们意识到的一件事是，这非常依赖于网站。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have a bunch of prompts, and we run it across a huge variety of models and providers, and then we look at the accuracy, we look at the speed, but this is going to depend highly on what type of site, like how big is the site, how, I don't know, what different
zh: 所以我们有一堆提示词，我们在大量不同的模型和提供商上运行，然后我们看准确性，我们看速度，但这会高度依赖于网站类型，比如网站有多大，怎么讲，不同的……

speaker: Unknown
en: Area is the site targeting, what type of commerce it is, and so on.
zh: 网站针对的是什么领域，是什么样的电商类型，等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, we run this evaluation continuously.
zh: 所以，我们持续运行这个评估。

speaker: Unknown
en: We use Promfoo.
zh: 我们用 Promfoo。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anybody heard about Promfoo?
zh: 有人听说过 Promfoo 吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, some people.
zh: 好，有一些人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, PromptFoo allows you to evaluate models and prompts against multiple models providers, and you can do local models and a bunch of OpenAI-compatible providers and a lot of them, basically.
zh: 所以，PromptFoo 让你可以针对多个模型提供商评估模型和提示词，你可以做本地模型和一大堆 OpenAI 兼容的提供商，基本上很多都可以。

speaker: Unknown
en: We look for two things.
zh: 我们看两样东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Accuracy.
zh: 准确性。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's typically what people look for.
zh: 这通常是大家看的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But also, we want the speed, because we don't want the site generation to take more than one or two seconds.
zh: 但我们也要速度，因为我们不想让网站生成花超过一两秒的时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because people, this is already proven that people want, the faster the site, the more conversions it generates, or the better the experience it is for the user.
zh: 因为人们，这已经被证明了：网站越快，产生的转化就越多，或者对用户的体验就越好。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I mentioned is different sites may have different requirements, so you may have to run this evaluation of models depending on the site.
zh: 我提到的是,不同的站点可能有不同的要求,所以你可能需要根据站点来运行这个模型评估。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 这是一个……我们固定了这些查询中的一部分,所以对于这个示例站点我们有 15 个提示词,而且我们有……在顶部,你可以看到用 Cerebras 搭配上上周发布的 Gemma 4 模型,我们生成一个页面的平均延迟可以达到 1.1 秒。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can compare that to the second one, which is 4.6 seconds.

speaker: Unknown
en: So the difference is huge.
zh: 所以差距非常大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why we use Cerebras for this use case.
zh: 这就是我们在这个用例中使用 Cerebras 的原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see that different providers, different models have different speeds.
zh: 你可以看到,不同的提供商、不同的模型有不同的速度。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't need to be perfect, but they're good enough if they're fast enough, so that's gonna be the kind of decisions that you need to make on whether the model is good enough for your use case or not.
zh: 它们不需要完美,但如果它们足够快,就足够好了,所以这就是你需要做的那种决策,判断这个模型对你的用例来说是否足够好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, we're looking, yeah, average 1.1 seconds, and then the next ones are going from four seconds higher.
zh: 是的,我们在看,是的,平均 1.1 秒,然后接下来的那些从四秒往上走。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you don't need a huge LLM to do this sort of work because you are generating text, you are deciding where to put blogs and how to organize the website.
